correctness.rationale: The nilpotent algebra V⊕F_q z with multiplication (u,s)(v,t)=(0,uᵀMv) has R³=0 and yields a two-sided brace and involutive solution. Two-sided flip requires uᵀMv=vᵀMu=0; one-sided probability is q^{-d}+(1-q^{-d})/q. For nonzero u, the two independent linear equations have q^{d-2} partner vectors, but q^{d-1} if u lies on a cosquare eigenspace; counting these yields the published universal formula for s(M) and P_flip,1. For dimension two, δ=(b-c)²/det M gives discriminant δ(δ-4), with symmetric/alternating, defective, split and nonsplit types. Counting symmetric matrices by determinant and using Σχ(δ(δ-4))=-1 gives the four exact labeled multiplicities and their collapse to three values when q=3. Independently enumerated every M∈GL₂(F_q) for q=3,5,7,11 and each cosquare eigenvector count; all four row multiplicities and total |GL₂| match. Algebraic proof extends to every odd prime power; prime-field experiments alone do not.
